openings.claim: Keep insertion stops and adjustable elastic clamps but remove simultaneous load bearing: clamp each rod, then swing its stop clear; clamp alone holds registration. Tentatively use four trimmed plywood pieces as two orthogonal datum seats, two as captive pivot leaves, bolts for seats/pivots/adjustable-loop anchors, cord retaining hardware. Closed stops provide fixed insertion contact; retract both without compensating adjustments.
openings.discriminator: If competing stop contact/clamp seating causes error, retraction should reduce return displacement, especially with 18 mm substitution, without increasing loaded displacement versus identical assembly with stops engaged. Rival clamp friction/compliance or operator seating predicts no repeatability gain or worse drift. Both mechanisms remain speculative; two supplied trials establish neither.
openings.probe: Within 100-minute fabrication establish captivity, insertion contacts, clearance and 90 mm envelope; abandon if incompatible. Two configurations, twelve exchanges each: five per original 19/20 mm rod, then two 18 mm substitutions for smaller rod. Alternate configuration blocks; restore marked setup before each; log total exchange time including retraction and return displacement. Never reseat after retraction. Four ten-second 10 N load trials/configuration spanning both rod sizes; log loaded displacement. Stay within 20-minute testing budget. Twelve exchanges do not establish full original-rod endurance under every load.
openings.uncertainty: Fit explicitly uncertain: bolt lengths permitting captive assembly/anchors, adjustable elastic closing force against datums without rod modification, loop capacity, and undisturbed retraction are unverified. Defeat: absent return advantage; any target/load/time failure; hardware escape; envelope excess; fabrication/testing overrun. All constraints bind. Feasibility/elastic restraint unknown; comparator authorizes neither deployment nor performance promise.

lineage.reason: Preserves interface-break relation, comparator/rival, caveats, stopping conditions and uncertain fit.

decision: Retain R1 for bounded comparison. Require 2 mm target circle after five exchanges of each rod and throughout ten-second 10 N loading; each exchange <40 seconds. No rod drilling, adhesive or permanent marks; hand operation only; no falling components. Joint within 90 mm cube. Supplied resources only.
